rule: Loki Music mobile and desktop use one shared product implementation. Shared features are edited once in packages/mobile/src and are consumed by iOS, Android and Expo Web. Platform-specific code is limited to adapters for browser/native capabilities; duplicated feature screens are forbidden.

behavioralParity.rule: Mobile/TestFlight and Web must use the same gameplay, catalogue, anti-duplicate, result-copy and business rules. Platform branches may only adapt native/browser capabilities (audio engine, microphone, animations, deep links).
protectedModules: Battle/Solo catalogue selection and theme filters

requirements: PASSER updates the visible card immediately; persistence must not block navigation
Swipe up remains optional and advances immediately
Battle Solo result hold is at most 700ms before advancing
iOS preloads the next Battle preview without resetting AVAudioSession while the current preview is playing
TestFlight build must be newer than or equal to the last audio/Battle parity commit before declaring parity
Web viewport emulation never counts as proof of native iOS audio parity

designProfiles.rule: Les fonctions sont identiques sur téléphone et ordinateur ; seul le DESIGN est séparé, par profil (mobile / desktop / wide) défini UNE fois dans designProfile.ts. Aucun écran dupliqué. La connexion ordinateur reste QR uniquement.
